questions.question: In the four-mark question 'solve 2x² − 7x + 2 = 0 correct to two decimal places', name where each of the four marks is paid.
questions.expected_answer: One mark for substitution into the quadratic formula; one for the discriminant 49 − 16 = 33; one for each rounded root, x ≈ 3,19 and x ≈ 0,31, paid only at two-decimal accuracy with rounding done once at the end.

questions.question: Walk the mark-by-mark solution of the five-mark first-principles question for f(x) = 2x² + 3.
questions.expected_answer: Mark 1: definition with limit symbol, f′(x) = lim(h→0) [f(x+h) − f(x)]/h. Mark 2: f(x+h) = 2x² + 4xh + 2h² + 3. Mark 3: difference = 4xh + 2h². Mark 4: divide by h to get 4x + 2h. Mark 5: take the limit, f′(x) = 4x, with the limit symbol retained on every line until it is used.

questions.question: For the loan question (R750 000, 9,6% p.a. compounded monthly, 300 payments), state the formula used, the values of i and n, and the resulting payment and total interest.
questions.expected_answer: Present value annuity: P = x[1 − (1+i)⁻ⁿ]/i with i = 0,096 ÷ 12 = 0,008 and n = 300. Solving for x gives about R6 604,94 per month. Total repaid ≈ 300 × 6 604,94 ≈ R1 981 500, so interest ≈ R1,23 million — more than the amount borrowed.
